recommendationReason: The target-neutral release builder, exact target registry, immutable planner, and normalized single-instance lifecycle orchestration are implemented, including leases, interruption resume, standalone retention-bound backup plan/apply, verified backup manifests, activation generation fencing, served-path failure rollback, explicit code-only rollback, destructive restore with paused verification and separate activation, bounded logs, authenticated inspection, hash-chained receipts, and a fail-closed local control-audit chain.
